item.title: ConformTxt 0.6.32
item.description: - Word and Outlook: the first ⌘V in a document no longer stops with "the cursor moved" and an invisible character left selected. It pastes, matched, on the first press. - Word and Outlook: the paste takes the document's own font (Aptos and the other Office fonts) instead of Helvetica. - Settings: the testing switch (Allow Claude to test) is gone.
